comparison_boundaries.gpt41_vs_gpt56_none: Descriptive cross-platform comparison. GPT-4.1 omits reasoning effort; GPT-5.6 uses none. Model, provider, endpoint, serving path, context limits, cache implementation, and price differ.
comparison_boundaries.gpt56_low_vs_high: Reasoning-effort sensitivity on the same Bedrock Mantle path, with frozen tasks, common prompts, graders, output ceilings, and other request controls. Run-window/service variation and sample uncertainty still limit generalization.
comparison_boundaries.gpt56_none_vs_low_high: Descriptive: these runs also differ in timing, some output ceilings, and overlapping suite execution. The same GPT-4.1 baseline is repeated only for reference. See the executed settings for per-process and observed cross-suite concurrency.

metric_treatment: All planned cases stay in their denominators. F1 is not a count of successful documents. Unlike quality metrics are not averaged.
reference_scope: Links identify public benchmark sources, not redistribution rights or the exact selected inputs. This export contains no source examples or per-case logs.
reproduction_scope: Offline aggregate-report reproduction only. Full source/run identifiers remain in the internal review record.
stage_treatment: Only full-stage observations are scored; smoke, pilot, and development runs are not pooled.
